name: minepulse
description: MinePulse - private Minecraft Paper server monitoring platform (dashboard + API + Paper agent).

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @minepulse/api --if-present && npm run build -w @minepulse/dashboard --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @minepulse/shared && npm run typecheck -w @minepulse/api --if-present && npm run typecheck -w @minepulse/dashboard --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test -w @minepulse/shared --if-present && npm run test -w @minepulse/api --if-present && npm run test -w @minepulse/dashboard --if-present
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,dash -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @minepulse/api" "npm run dev -w @minepulse/dashboard"
